expected: A request carrying the pre-expired bearer token (tokens/agent-expired.token) is rejected at the transport with 401 before any tool executes, the error mentions expiry at most generically and leaks no agent enumeration, and nothing is written to the decision log.
observed: curl POST /mcp with the expired bearer returned HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized, body 'invalid token' (Content-Length 14), for both tools/list and initialize. The message is fully generic (does not even name expiry). A random 64-hex bearer produced a byte-identical 401 'invalid token' body with comparable sub-millisecond timing (0.0003s vs 0.0008s), so there is no oracle distinguishing expired from invalid. audit list --agent agent-expired returned null (no decision-log record, no tool executed). Broker stayed healthy: a valid mcp-call --list-tools as agent-097 returned the tool set.
evidence: curl -s -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8770/mcp -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat tokens/agent-expired.token)" -d '{...tools/list...}' => 'HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized' / Content-Length: 14 / body 'invalid token'. initialize with same token => http_code=401 time=0.000286. Random bearer => http_code=401 time=0.000839, body 'invalid token' (identical shape). './bin/taskgrant audit list --config ./config.yaml --json --agent agent-expired --limit 5' => null. './bin/mcp-call --token-file tokens/agent-097.token --list-tools' => healthy tool list returned.
commands: curl -s -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8770/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat tokens/agent-expired.token)" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http_code=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}\n' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8770/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat tokens/agent-expired.token)" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"curl","version":"1"}}}'
